name: Himanshi Citlali
location: The Oxidian Market, Geartown, near Ashland and Chicago Ave
description:
Himanshi Citlali is a broad-shouldered woman whose face has been mapped by sixty years of steam, smoke, and squinting into wok-fire. Her skin is deep brown and perpetually damp at the temples, her silver-threaded locs pinned under a flame-orange headwrap that people in Geartown can spot from three stalls away. She has cosmetic bioluminescent veins along her forearms â€” pale gold, faint as candlelight â€” a gift she bought herself when the stall finally turned profit. Her stall, a converted Ferrogate Transit cargo module welded open on one side, serves a rotating menu of Sahelian-Polynesian fusion that she has been quietly perfecting for thirty years: tamarind-braised uru fruit over millet, coconut-marinated goat offal on skewers, a fermented taro drink she calls 'slow water' that locals swear cures radiation headaches.

She is the kind of woman who listens more than she speaks, who remembers every regular's order, their family troubles, their unpaid debts. She extends credit to people she trusts with a nod and collects it with a raised eyebrow â€” no ledger, no apps, all memory. She has a temper she keeps banked low, like a cooking coal, and the rare people who see it come alive tend not to provoke it twice. She prays each morning to the E.L.F. she calls Grandmother Ember, leaving a thimble of slow water on the stall's power node.

core_fears: Losing the stall â€” the last thing she built that is truly hers
Dying before she passes her recipes to someone worthy
core_desires: To be remembered as someone who fed people well
To find out what happened to her daughter Amara who disappeared into a Tessera labor contract eight years ago
coping_mechanisms: Ritual prayer to Grandmother Ember E.L.F.
blind_spots: Overestimates her ability to read people she has mothered into trust
Cannot see that her nephew Tunde is skimming from the supply runs
psychology.secret: She has been quietly funneling Î¦15â€“20 a month to a data broker named Vestin who claims he is still tracking Amara's contract trail. She has paid him for four years and suspects he is stringing her along but cannot bring herself to stop.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Warm, economical. West African French loanwords woven into Meridian standard. Calls everyone 'child' or their name, never slang diminutives.
speech_patterns.cadence: Slow and deliberate, like she has all the time in the world, even when she doesn't.
verbal_tics: Clicking her tongue before delivering a hard truth
Referring to bad luck as 'the wind changing'
example_lines: 'You look like you haven't eaten since Tuesday. Sit down, child, the news will keep.'
'I don't deal in rumors. I deal in soup. But sit long enough and one becomes the other.'

story_hooks: She has a worn Tessera subsidiary contract number that might lead to Amara â€” but whoever holds the contract doesn't want to be found.
A body was found behind the Oxidian Market three weeks ago. Oumou recognized the tattoo but told the city drones nothing. She'll tell the right person â€” for the right reason.
narrative_function: Local anchor and information node â€” she knows every face that passes through Geartown, dispenses advice alongside food, can point players toward people or trouble. Quest giver for missing persons among the market community.
augmentations: Cosmetic bioluminescent subdermal veins (pale gold, forearms). Reinforced knee joints â€” functional, not cosmetic, from decades of standing.
daily_life: Wakes before dawn to prep stock in the stall's back compartment, opens by 0600, runs service until mid-evening. Sends her nephew Tunde to source spices from the Alban Souk twice a week.
affiliation: Independent; loosely aligned with The Oxidian Market vendors guild; The Ferment

decision_rules: Never extend credit to someone she hasn't fed at least three times
Always protect her regulars before herself
Never involve herself in corporate disputes â€” they eat people
escalation_ladder: Quiet assessment â€” watching more than talking
Firm redirection â€” 'this isn't a conversation for my stall'
The banked temper surfaces: cold, quiet, absolute

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Generous, watchful, slow to trust but fast to feed
interpersonal_modes.friends: Fiercely loyal, will lie to authorities without hesitation, uses blunt love as her primary language

stress_responses.low: Cooks something complicated that doesn't need to be complicated
stress_responses.medium: Goes silent, moves mechanically through service, prays at the node
stress_responses.high: Makes a decision she has been putting off for months â€” resolves things rather than collapses

contradictions: Preaches non-involvement in faction politics while quietly funding a years-long private investigation
Says she trusts no one but runs her entire business on trust and memory
habits: Wipes down the counter even when it's clean
Tucks a small dried pepper into her headwrap as a good-luck token
Tastes every dish three times before service
breaking_points: Finding out Tunde has been stealing from her
Someone threatening a child at her stall

carried_weapons: Forge-Smith Collective Ablonite Push Dagger 'Bone Key'

physical_description.heritage: Complex genetic mosaic: 31.5% Indigenous American (Mesoamerican/Andean), 25.2% Sub-Saharan African, 21% South Asian, 11.7% East Asian, 10.6% Southeast Asian. This blending produces warm medium-deep brown skin with layered undertonesâ€”earthen and ochre from Indigenous ancestry, rich amber from African heritage, subtle olive from South Asian genetics, and warm golden undertones from East/Southeast Asian components. The result is dimensional and complex rather than monochromatic.
physical_description.build: Broad-shouldered and substantial, with the dense musculature of someone who has spent three decades standing over heat sources and moving cast-iron cookware. Not fat, but solidâ€”the kind of frame that reads as immovable once rooted.
physical_description.hair_length: Long (past shoulders when unpinned), always contained under headwrap
physical_description.eye_color: Dark brown, slightly rheumed from decades of smoke exposure
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm medium-deep brown with layered undertones: ochre and earthen from Indigenous American ancestry, rich amber-bronze from Sub-Saharan African heritage, subtle olive from South Asian genetics, warm golden notes from East/Southeast Asian components. The blend creates a dimensional, non-monochromatic complexion.
physical_description.complexion: Weathered but dignified. Fine lines map her forehead and eyes from perpetual squinting into wok-fire. Skin perpetually damp at temples from ambient heat. Slight forward crease between brows from decades of concentration. Cheekbones carry pronounced angular structure reflecting Indigenous American ancestry. Facial structure shows subtle influence from South Asian and African heritage in the width of nose and fullness of lips. No cosmetic skin workâ€”her age is worn openly.
distinguishing_marks: Bioluminescent subdermal veins running along both forearms in pale goldâ€”faint as candlelight, most visible in dim light or evening hours
Stress fracture scarring on left knee joint (invisible beneath clothing, evident in gait)
Small burn marks scattered across inner forearms and wristsâ€”occupational, accumulated over thirty years of cooking
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Pale gold bioluminescent veins tracing her forearms in organic, branching patterns. No chrome or obvious mechanical augmentationâ€”the veins are her only visible mod, and subtle enough that strangers might assume they're tattoos until they glow.
physical_description.posture_movement: She stands rooted, weight balanced evenly on both feet unless actively working. Moves with economical grace when cookingâ€”no wasted motion. Her gait shows a slight favoring of her right leg, consequence of reinforced knee joints. When listening, she tends to tilt her head slightly and narrow her eyes, as if parsing both words and subtext. Her hands are always in motion or intentionally stillâ€”no fidgeting.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 4 utilitarian, with personal flair. Foundational: heat-resistant canvas apron (indigo, stained with decades of turmeric and char), reinforced utility pants (charcoal), slip-resistant cooking clogs. Over this: a loose linen shirt (cream or rust-colored, sleeves rolled to show the bioluminescent veins). Always, always the flame-orange headwrapâ€”hand-dyed, replaced twice yearly, her signature. A single hammered brass cuff on her left wrist, acquired from a metalsmith in the Alban Souk fifteen years ago. No jewelry beyond this. Her clothing is functional Tier 4â€”not fashionable, but well-maintained and clearly chosen for durability and ease of movement in a kitchen environment.
